items.note: Each capability path the proposal lists must have a delta spec at exactly specs/<capability-path>/spec.md.

sources.quote: New capabilities: use the exact path from the proposal at `specs/<capability-path>/spec.md`.

items.note: Every segment of the capability path must be kebab-case (lowercase words joined by hyphens).

sources.quote: Any path segment newly introduced in the proposal must be kebab-case.

items.note: Needs a nesting-depth comparison between new capability paths and the existing main-spec layout at BASE_SHA; no kind can express this.

sources.quote: do not add a new domain level when the project uses a flat layout.

items.note: A modified capability's delta path must equal an existing main-spec path; no kind can tell modified deltas apart from new ones.

sources.quote: Modified capabilities: use the exact existing path from `openspec/specs/<capability-path>/` when creating the delta

items.note: Moving or renaming a capability means writing under openspec/specs/; no such write may happen during ff.

sources.quote: use the exact existing path from `openspec/specs/<capability-path>/` ... Do not move or rename the capability.

items.note: Checking that spec files were written one at a time (not batched in one call) needs a per-capability write-separation check, which no kind provides.

sources.quote: Write the spec files one at a time, so the user sees progress and an interrupted run keeps the files it already wrote:

items.note: Resume order (start with the first capability that has no file) is not expressible.

sources.quote: Before writing anything, compare the capabilities the proposal lists with the `specs/<capability-path>/spec.md` files that already exist, and start with the first capability that has no file.
Do not rewrite an existing file unless the user asks you to.
Stop when every capability the proposal lists has its file.

items.downgrade_reason: The skip_specs: true exception in .openspec.yaml cannot be expressed as an applies_when predicate.

sources.quote: There must be at least one spec file unless the change's `.openspec.yaml` sets `skip_specs: true`

items.downgrade_reason: Applies only when skip_specs is not set; that condition cannot be expressed.

sources.quote: If the proposal lists no capabilities and `skip_specs` is not set, revisit the proposal first.

Delta operations (use ## headers):
      - **ADDED Requirements**: New capabilities
      - **MODIFIED Requirements**: Changed behavior ... - **REMOVED Requirements**: Deprecated features

items.note: Implicit rule: new behavior goes under ## ADDED Requirements.

unitemized.reason: 'Follow the project's existing organization' is too vague to check mechanically; its one checkable part (no new domain level in a flat layout) is covered as schema-043.
Applies only to modified capabilities, and whether the proposal or deltas hold modified capabilities cannot be expressed as an applies_when predicate (rule 7).
Whether a standalone store is registered cannot be observed with the reference predicates, so the condition on --store use cannot be expressed.
